newsitem.title: POLAND: PBR underwrites part of BEST issue.
newsitem.headline: PBR underwrites part of BEST issue.

text.p: Polish Development Bank (PBR) will underwrite 500,000 shares in the February public offering of the BEST PH SA trading and financial operations firm, the bank said in a statement late on Monday.
PBR said it would underwrite 166,700 of the 500,000 existing shares BEST was offering the public and 333,300 shares of the one million new shares it was offering.
The statement said the stand-by fee was three percent but that the issue price for the shares would have to be at least 34 zlotys.
PBR holds the right to contract sub-underwriters but will not be compensated in the event it takes up shares.
BEST's 1.2 million existing shares have been approved for public trade.
Large investors can subscribe for between 10,000 and 800,000 of the new shares between February 2 and February 21, when they can subscribe for at least 10,000 of the 400,000 existing shares.
From February 17 to February 28 small investors will subscribe for 200,000 of the new shares and 100,000 of the existing shares.
The company, based in the northern city of Sopot and employing 311 people, seeks a listing on the main market.
Earlier this month Best said that Wood Securities BV and Bank Rozwoju Eksportu SA BRE agreed to underwrite the issue.
